title: Real-time deforestation anomaly detection using YOLO and Landsat satellite imagery
focus: Object detection & Deep Learning (YOLO) on Landsat satellite imagery for real-time deforestation alerting
methodology: YOLO-based satellite patch anomaly detection with temporal difference verification
key_takeaway: Achieved >91% mAP in near-real-time deforestation hotspot detection from multi-spectral imagery.

title: TransSiamUNet based transformer-augmented Siamese-U-Net for precise change detection in satellite imagery
authors: Ali F, Labib SS, Mahmoud A, Fattoh IE.
focus: Siamese Neural Networks & Vision Transformers (ViT) for bi-temporal satellite change detection
methodology: TransSiamUNet: Siamese encoder extracting multi-temporal features + Vision Transformer for long-range spatial context + U-Net decoder for pixel-wise change segmentation
key_takeaway: Achieved 0.94 accuracy and 0.89 F1-score on satellite change detection, outperforming standard U-Net.

title: Random Forest Detection of charcoal driven vegetation loss and deforestation in forest-savannah transitions
authors: Arko T, Mensah A, Obani P, Denton F, Adomako J.
focus: Supervised Machine Learning (Random Forest) + NDVI time series for vegetation loss tracking
methodology: Multi-temporal Landsat imagery, NDVI vegetation indices, Random Forest classifier with Out-of-Bag validation
key_takeaway: Documented 75% forest cover loss with Out-of-Bag error rates below 0.04% using spectral vegetation features.

title: The fast and the focused: Balancing timely and accurate classification of deforestation using satellite time-series
focus: Temporal satellite imagery analysis, early deforestation warning systems, and tradeoff between detection speed vs accuracy
methodology: Time-series change detection using harmonic regression models and ensemble classifiers on Sentinel-2 and Landsat
key_takeaway: Developed early warning trigger algorithms that detect forest clearing within 12 days of occurrence.

title: Natural forests of the world - a 2020 baseline for deforestation monitoring
focus: Global high-resolution baseline map of intact, degraded, and regenerating forests for AI change detection comparison
methodology: Multi-decadal Landsat/Sentinel time-series processing at 30m and 10m spatial resolution
key_takeaway: Provides the international ground truth benchmark against which AI deforestation models calibrate baseline forest boundaries.

title: Image processing and AI techniques for climate change & deforestation detection using remote sensing
authors: Agarwal A, Kumar S, Rajini GK, Vairavasundaram I.
focus: Systematic review of AI architectures (U-Net, DeepLab, Transformers, RF) for remote sensing forest loss
methodology: Comprehensive comparative evaluation of CNNs, Transformers, and classical ML across optical and SAR imagery
key_takeaway: U-Net and Siamese architectures dominate pixel-level forest change detection, with IoU gains of 12-18% over thresholding.

title: A dataset of forest regrowth in globally key deforestation regions using satellite data
focus: Secondary forest regrowth and post-deforestation dynamics across tropical biomes
methodology: Annual satellite time-series classification with ground validation plots across Amazon, Congo, and SE Asia
key_takeaway: Enables AI models to differentiate permanent forest clearing from rotational slash-and-burn and regrowth.

title: Agricultural expansion and mining drive forest loss in tropical regions: A remote sensing analysis
focus: Land use / land cover (LULC) transition mapping and driver attribution using remote sensing and ML
methodology: Supervised classification using spectral indices (NDVI, NBR, NDWI) and Support Vector Machines / Random Forest
key_takeaway: Achieved 92.4% overall classification accuracy for isolating agricultural deforestation frontiers.

title: High-resolution satellite maps show rubber plantations cause substantial tropical deforestation
focus: High-resolution satellite deep learning mapping of monoculture crop-driven deforestation
methodology: Convolutional Neural Networks applied to 10-meter Sentinel-2 imagery with phenology time series
key_takeaway: Revealed 4 million hectares of previously untracked deforestation using deep learning phenological signatures.

title: Research progress on multimodal data fusion in forest resource & disturbance monitoring
authors: Wang M, Zhang Q, Liu X, Zhang J, Yu F, Zhang X, Zhao R.
focus: Multimodal remote sensing fusion (Optical + SAR Radar + LiDAR) for all-weather forest monitoring
methodology: Air-space-ground collaborative network combining Sentinel-1 SAR (penetrating cloud cover) and Sentinel-2 optical
key_takeaway: Multimodal optical+SAR fusion reduces false alarm deforestation rates caused by cloud cover by up to 35%.
